name: opthub
description: Measures whether a cheaper way of running a coding agent does the same job: the opt CLI, the Optimization Hub, and the sandbox providers it runs arms in.

scripts.test: node app/test/tune.test.mjs && node app/test/ult.test.mjs && node app/test/hub-graph.test.mjs && node app/test/behaviour.test.mjs && node app/test/claude-p.test.mjs && node app/test/demo-startup.test.mjs && node app/test/bulk-read.test.mjs && node sandbox/test.mjs
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix app/web ci && npm --prefix app/web run build
